mappings.note: Live copies notes with Option+drag. Ardour CopyModifier defaults to Control (Secondary); remapping to Option (Level4) needs input/preference changes and may collide with other Option uses.

mappings.note: Installed copy-drag uses Control (CopyModifier), not Live's Option.
Splits selected notes on grid boundaries. Live also documents split at time-selection start/end as a dual path; Ardour's discrete action is grid-only.
Live chops in increments of 1 via Cmd+E+drag. Ardour exposes discrete Notes/split-notes-more (profile s) and split-notes-less (Tertiary-s); there is no Cmd+E drag gesture.

evidence.reference: Search scope: chop notes by drag gesture. Terms: split-notes-more, Cmd+E drag. Subsystems: midi_view, editing_context. Discrete actions only.

mappings.note: Discrete split-more key, not Live's Cmd+E drag.

mappings.note: Discrete split-less key, not Live's Cmd+Shift+E drag.

fit-selection already on f.
Quantizes selected MIDI notes. In Clip/Pianoroll context the inspector QuantizeWidget applies without a modal; the Editor MIDI path still presents QuantizeDialog then applies on OK.
